name: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment
summary: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment arrives in Ironforge for the Test of Righteousness. The metal is prepared for blacksmith Jordan Stilwell to forge a holy weapon.

sections.title: A Smith's Materials
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell needs rare materials for a weapon worthy of a paladin. He requires a Purified Kor Gem, sturdy Whitestone Oak lumber, his lost smithing hammer, and refined ore. The shipment brings the metal to Ironforge for this sacred labor.

faq.q: What is Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment used for?
aliases: what does jordan do with ore
faq.answer: The refined ore goes to Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge. It is one of four key components for a masterwork weapon for paladins undertaking the Test of Righteousness.
Bailor arranges the shipment and oversees the refining and dispatch of the specialist metal Jordan Stilwell needs.

faq.q: Why does Jordan need this specific shipment?
aliases: why cant jordan use regular iron
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell plans to craft a symbol of paladinhood and the Light. He needs superior materials beyond ordinary forge scraps, and the specially processed metal gives the blade or hammer head the balance and purity worthy of a holy knight.

angles.text: As a paladin, you must show patience and dedication to obtain this refined shipment. It is one of the physical trials required to craft your symbolic weapon of the Light.
As a blacksmith, you know masterwork forging calls for flawless, carefully prepared ingots instead of raw field ore.
